verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs describe auto-updating saved Queries, an AI 'agents skill' for scripted bulk edits, and an MCP/local API for AI assistants to read/write data—but all of these are manually invoked (a query view, or an agent run by a human/tool) rather than a rules engine that fires actions automatically on defined events (e.g. webhooks, triggers, conditional automations). No evidence describes event-based rule definitions or automatic triggers.
